A pleasant discovery, a pleasant surprise
Feb 2025 • Family
We chose this restaurant because it was clean from the outside.
Inside, the welcome, the cuisine and the quality of the products comfort us in our choice.
The welcome is warm, fast services.
The cuisine is traditional, and the quality of the products is impeccable: the visible freshness of the fish and fruits, the pork is not greasy.
The portions are generous.
The prices are reasonable, for two people we are used to having 2 courses, a beer and rice, and we have never paid more than 300,000 đồng (11 euros)
For the last ten days “BEP AN” has become our main restaurant.

Warm hosts, but very disappointing food-wise!
Feb 2025 • Couples
We went here because of the good recommendations and were bitterly disappointed twice! The family and their staff are very nice and friendly! The food, however, is really tasteless. We've been traveling through Asia for years, but this is nothing! Completely unseasoned dishes and at comparatively high prices. The restaurant seems to appeal mainly to unsuspecting tourists! For example, I had the Squid, which is considered one of the most expensive dishes at 300k and a recommendation of the house! I've never eaten it that shabby. The Panadev completely tasteless and with closed eyes it would have tasted like fried onion rings. You could only eat it with half a litre of chilli sauce. My wife had pepper steak that didn't taste like pepper at all. We used all the contents of the pepper shaker to get a little flavor! The spring rolls eat in Otdnung, fresh but also not flavorful! . Asia has such great aromatic spices, why none here in the kitchen. Finding enlightenment remains a mystery to me😩

You always find the pearl the last night!?
Jan 2025 • Couples
We dived in here our last night of nearly 3 weeks stay at Long beach after good recommendations and crowded place at our daily walks to and from the beach. I fell in love with Phu qpuc and the Vietnamese cuisine 10 years ago and we both longed for the culinary experience we had on the island 5 years ago we visited the island last time. We have been so disappointed by the touristization of the kitchens and food poisoning in batches. But now, of course, on the last night of our trip, we'll be mesmerized again. The food tastes just like really solid Vietnamese food should, the service is friendly and fast. Price more than reasonable. The menu lacks burgers, pizza and fried fast food. Best dining experience on our three weeks on the island! Thank you!!
